rules.title: No decorative glyphs in prose
rules.text: Emoji and dingbats in a document that is read as evidence are decoration: the sentence reads the same without them. Box-drawing characters a format defines, and arrows between measurements, are not decoration.

judgement.question: Is this glyph decoration in the document's own prose, rather than part of a quoted tool output, a diagram, or a symbol the text defines?

criteria.true: it decorates a heading, a list item or a sentence that reads the same without it
criteria.false: it is inside quoted command output or a diagram, or the surrounding text defines it as a symbol with a meaning
